issues.description: Transactions_Data_2015.dta is required by the only data read but is not among the datasheet and do-file inventoried in this package. This is a missing package input; current access to the authors’ prepared file is unverified, not a confirmed access barrier.

The datasheet says Stata data manipulation/construction occurred, but the supplied program starts by loading Transactions_Data_2015.dta and contains only figures, statistics, regressions and exports. The full field/type contract, row unit/key, transaction population/history and producer mapping for the required analysis variables are not documented.
The program hardcodes a Windows G: data directory and 32 Windows G: Results output filenames. A host Stata batch run needs one coherent relative execution root with Data/ and writable Results/ paths.

The supplied do-file places graph-wide yr filters after the graph options comma; places if qualifiers after option commas in four summarize, two reg and thirty reghdfe calls; and places using filenames after option commas in ten esttab calls. Primary command documentation supports precise moves that preserve the existing filters, model specifications, options and output filenames.

The full supplied workflow is one 377-line Stata do-file. It reads one unprovided prepared table and then runs its figures, Table 1A-C, Tables 2A-7 and Appendices B1-B4D. No separate data-construction program or analysis-only prepared-data branch is supplied, so no analysis_only scope is justified.
